issue_request: FHIR-25027 was Published/Persuasive for R5 as a FHIR-I technical correction. It asked to correct profile differentials that represented choice-type constraints with typed paths such as Extension.valueString instead of constraining Extension.value[x] with the desired type.
initial_application: Core commit 9346c8cc45620d9fa9ddead75a94a3cb8b9491c5 changed the legacy SpreadsheetParser extension-generation logic to always name generated Extension value elements value[x]. A 2019 FHIR-I Zulip technical-correction thread also records GF#25027 as approved.
additional_context: The legacy parser was later removed from this checkout, and core no longer directly carries the affected iso21090 extension definitions. The active core iso-21090 profile page links to Extension Pack definitions; the Extension Pack postBox definition already uses Extension.value[x] with type string. A bounded residual search found no top-level Extension.value<Type> paths in core, but found address-official, a separate active Extension Pack extension from FHIR-43838, with typed value paths.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source change is justified because the seed example and current core source are already correct, and the only discovered residual same-pattern issue is in the Extension Pack repository.
